subject: Mutual plan: security intake cadence, questionnaire & SOC2 evidence owners (TideCap)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@tidecap.com>
Cc: security@tidecap.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft: security intake cadence & SOC 2 evidence owners

Alex / TideCap security team — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) milestone focused on the security review and SOC 2 evidence delivery so we can hit your procurement window. Attachment: TideCap_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.docx; Evidence_Request_Template.xlsx.

High-level ask / milestones (proposed):
- M1 (Questionnaire delivery): Redwood sends questionnaire & evidence template — DONE (attached). Owner: Redwood (Vanessa). Target due date from TideCap: 10 business days after receipt.
- M2 (Evidence intake): TideCap returns populated questionnaire + initial evidence bundle (logs/configs/policies). Owner: TideCap Security (Olivia/Alex). Target: 2026-03-02.
- M3 (Review & clarifications): Redwood reviews evidence, flags gaps, and schedules a 45-min security sync for clarifications. Owner: Redwood (Marissa). Target: 2026-03-06.
- M4 (Final evidence snapshot & SOC-2 artefacts): TideCap provides remaining items and confirmation for procurement. Owner: TideCap. Target: 2026-03-12.
- Close target (commercial sign): contingent on M4 + procurement approvals — target close: 2026-03-19.

Dependencies / assumptions:
- TideCap has access to the Evidence_Request_Template and can export the requested logs (auth logs, IAM snapshots, retained config archives) within the timelines above.
- Any third-party attestation documents (existing SOC 2 reports) will be uploaded to the Drive link; those speed up review.

Immediate asks / next steps for TideCap:
1) Confirm the TideCap security contact who will own returning the questionnaire and delivery cadence (suggested: Olivia Park).
2) Confirm whether your procurement deadline (end of March) requires an earlier target close — if so we can compress review windows.

If this MAP looks OK I will update the shared HubSpot deal record and send a calendar invite for the review sync after we receive the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: TideCap_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.docx (docx), Evidence_Request_Template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@tidecap.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft: security intake cadence & SOC 2 evidence owners

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear breakdown. Confirming TideCap security lead: Olivia Park (cc'd). Olivia, can you confirm the team can return the questionnaire by 2026-03-02? Our procurement deadline is the week of 2026-03-22, so hitting the 03-19 target close would be ideal.

A few quick questions from procurement/security:
- Will Redwood accept partial evidence (e.g., initial IAM exports + policy docs) to unblock the review while we pull historical logs?
- Does Redwood have any specific formatting requirements for exported logs (we typically provide JSON/CSV) — flagged in the Evidence_Request_Template but wanted to call out.

If it helps, we can arrange a short technical clarification call between Olivia and Marissa next week.

Regards,
Alex Morgan
Head of Partnerships, TideCap Financial
alex.morgan@tidecap.com | +1 (646) 555-4482

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@tidecap.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@tidecap.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + MAP draft: security intake cadence & SOC 2 evidence owners

Marissa / Ben / Karthik — forwarding TideCap's note. Can you confirm internal owners and whether the proposed targets are realistic? Key asks:
- Can Marissa lead the technical review (M3) and host a 45-min clarification call with Olivia?
- Ben, can you confirm we can accept partial evidence and the preferred formats (JSON/CSV ok)?
- Karthik, any concerns on the timeline from our infra side (e.g., is 6 business days between review and final snapshot sufficient)?

I'm proposing the following internal commitments if we want to keep the 2026-03-19 commercial close:
- Redwood to return review notes within 3 business days of receiving TideCap evidence.
- Schedule clarification call within 2 business days of review notes.
- Redwood to provide a final evidence acceptance checklist after call (owner: Marissa).

Please reply-all with short confirmations so I can update the HubSpot deal and lock calendar invites.

Thanks,
Vanessa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@tidecap.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@tidecap.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + MAP draft: security intake cadence & SOC 2 evidence owners

All — confirmed on our side. Quick commitments below; attaching an internal evidence intake checklist (we will also paste to the shared Drive).

Redwood commitments (owners & dates):
- Send questionnaire & evidence template: Vanessa (sent 2026-02-18).
- Review initial evidence & return annotated checklist: Marissa — target 3 business days after TideCap submits (we can commit to 2026-03-05 if TideCap submits by 2026-03-02).
- Clarification call: Marissa to host — 45 minutes, proposed window 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-09.
- Final evidence acceptance checklist & exceptions log: Marissa — target 1 business day after clarifications.
- Product infra validation (logs/retention check): Karthik — to confirm any items that require deeper infra access; target to respond within 2 business days of Marissa's annotated checklist.
- Sales/commercial signoff coordination: Ben — will coordinate with procurement once final acceptance is confirmed; Ben to own DocuSign issuance.

Answers to TideCap's questions: partial evidence is fine to start (IAM exports + policies are the highest priority). JSON/CSV is an acceptable format for logs; if you can also provide a small sample of parsed logs (1–2k lines) that speeds validation.

Next actions for TideCap (requested):
1) TideCap to return the populated questionnaire + a first evidence bundle by 2026-03-02.
2) If possible, upload any existing SOC-type reports (PDF) to the Drive link so we can short-circuit the review.

I'll attach the intake checklist to the Drive and post the invite for the clarification slot once Olivia confirms availability.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Internal_Evidence_Intake_Checklist.pdf (pdf)
